Subject: Open model distribution: certification & distribution program

Hi Camila —

Thanks again for the intro last month at the Inference Summit. ClearWeights is eager to get broader distribution for our 13B/30B open weights and we think Redwood's Dedicated and Private channels are exactly the right path for partners and enterprise consumers.

High level ask: we want to offer certified weights on Redwood with a simple, auditable distribution agreement that preserves our dual-license approach (research/ASL + commercial CLA) and includes:
- signed provenance (model file hashes + manifest)
- time-limited signed URLs for downloads (no public buckets)
- optional entitlements for premium evaluation (trial keys)
- a lightweight attestation flow for export control / sanctions checks

We attached a one-page Distribution Program overview (CW-Distribution-Program-v1.pdf). Can we get a 30–45min call with your partnerships + legal + security teams next week to review the mechanics?

If helpful, here's a quick onboarding checklist we think will be required:
1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (legal, security review, S3 access, billing).
2) Security artifact exchange (SOC2 cert, CI/CD attestations, model card).
3) License text confirmation (we'll share CLA + ASL variant).

Happy to be flexible on timing. Proposed times: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Partnerships, ClearWeights
attachments: CW-Distribution-Program-v1.pdf

Quick security assessment notes after a first pass. High-level gating checklist we should require before production distribution:
- Artifact provenance: signed manifests with SHA-256 for each weight shard + model card with training data summary.
- Supply chain: attestations for build pipeline (reproducible builds) and container SBOMs.
- Key management: customer KMS or Redwood-managed KMS with HSM for signing downloads.
- Access model: time-limited signed URLs + per-fingerprint entitlements; no public buckets.
- Telemetry & usage: tokenized telemetry for model usage (to detect exfiltration patterns).
- Licensing: explicit clause preventing rehosting on public mirrors for 90-day embargo; commercial CLA terms for redistribution.
- Export controls: vendor-provided sanctions check and an onboarding attestation.

I attached a short CSV checklist to map responsibilities (security-checklist.csv). If any item is a hard blocker for product, call it out — otherwise we can mark as "needs remediation during onboarding" and proceed with a staged rollout.

Karthik
Security — Redwood Inference
attachments: security-checklist.csv

Hi Lena —

Thanks for your patience while we lined up internal stakeholders. We've put together a concise 3-phase onboarding plan that should get ClearWeights weights into the Redwood catalog while protecting both parties and keeping time-to-revenue short. Attached: CW-Onboarding-Plan-v2.pdf

Phase 1 — Technical onboarding (2 weeks):
- Exchange model manifests + test artifacts (hashes + sample shards).
- Secure credentials: either Redwood-managed KMS signing or partner-signed artifacts via your HSM.
- Ingest pipeline dry-run to our staging Dedicated cluster.

Phase 2 — Legal & compliance (2–4 weeks, parallel):
- Sign weights access agreement (WAA) that references your ASL/CLA.
- Export-control attestation & basic sanctions check.

Phase 3 — Controlled distribution (rolling):
- Soft launch to partners / early enterprise (tiered entitlements).
- Telemetry for usage & quality monitoring; revenue-share billing enabled on cutover.

Next steps I propose:
1) Execute a short MAP (I attached our template) and confirm the signers for the WAA.
2) Sergio to propose revenue-share ranges and a commercial attachment for the WAA (Sergio, can you send by Fri?).
3) Lena — please upload the CLA/ASL and a sample model manifest; we'll run the security checklist and come back with any hard blockers.

I've created a HubSpot opportunity for this (HBSP-24819) and added a DocuSign link for an NDA/intro WAA draft here: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/XYZ-OpenModel-Onboarding

Would love to lock the MAP + call notes today so we can start the onboarding next week.

Best,
Camila Reyes
